'''Gordarl Weaponsmiths''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] weapons manufacturer in operation on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Gordal Weaponsmiths was known for its sonic weaponry, designed specifically for Geonosian physiology. After the Clone Wars, the company attempted to expand outside of Geonosis, but much of their technology could not be adapted to suit non-Geonosians.<ref name="NEGWT" />

As well as various types of sonic weapons, Gordarl Weaponsmiths also created the [[Containment field/Legends|containment field]] generator used to hold prisoners in the [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]].

The Gordarl Weaponsmiths was one of the most important industrial corporations of Geonosis, supplying the native Geonosians with most of their weapons, from high powered artillery pieces, such as the [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]] to the basic infantry [[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|blaster rifles]].

The company itself was a subsidiary of [[Geonosian Industries/Legends|Geonosian Industries]], the leading manufacturing company of Geonosis. Like most Geonosian companies it was controlled by the [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].
